diagnosis: The document collaboration channel returns user presence metadata without verifying workspace or document permissions. In Laravel broadcasting, returning a truthy value or array from a presence channel callback authorizes the client, allowing any user knowing a document UUID to join collaborative editing sessions and capture real-time diffs.
